title: Well-Posedness of Semimartingale Optimal Transport with Partial Marginal Constraints for Model Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2611.17902v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the well-posedness and stability of a semimartingale optimal transport problem with partial marginal constraints at several maturities, motivated by the calibration of financial models to finitely many option prices. We connect its probabilistic and Eulerian formulations within the Benamou--Brenier framework. Under convex-duality assumptions, we establish strong duality for every price vector in the extended-value sense and existence of a primal optimizer whenever the value is finite. Under additional PDE assumptions, we establish dual attainment on the relative interior of the admissible price set, together with uniqueness of the primal optimizer. Under further non-degeneracy assumptions, we show that this price set has nonempty interior, on which the dual optimizer is unique and depends locally Lipschitz continuously on the prices. The analysis combines convex methods with regularity and local strong convexity results for Hami

translated_title: 用于模型校准的带部分边际约束的半鞅最优传输问题的适定性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类在多个到期日具有部分边际约束的半鞅最优传输问题的适定性与稳定性，其研究动机来自将金融模型校准到有限多个期权价格的实际需求。我们在Benamou–Brenier框架内将该问题的概率表述与欧拉表述联系起来。在凸对偶假设下，我们以扩展值意义对每个价格向量建立了强对偶性，并在值有限时证明了原始优化器的存在性。在附加的偏微分方程（PDE）假设下，我们在容许价格集的相对内部上建立了对偶可达性，以及原始优化器的唯一性。在进一步的非退化假设下，我们证明了该价格集具有非空内部，且在该内部上对偶优化器是唯一的，并关于价格局部Lipschitz连续地依赖于价格。整个分析结合了凸分析方法与哈密顿量相关的正则性及局部强凸性结果。
tldr: 该论文针对受期权价格校准启发的多到期日部分边际约束半鞅最优传输问题，系统建立了其适定性与稳定性理论，包括强对偶性、原始与对偶优化器的存在性与唯一性，以及对偶优化器对价格的局部Lipschitz连续依赖性。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes well-posedness and stability for semimartingale optimal transport with partial marginal constraints at several maturities, motivated by calibrating financial models to finitely many option prices, proving strong duality, existence and uniqueness of primal and dual optimizers, and local Lipschitz continuous dependence of the dual optimizer on prices.
